## Overview

Apple filed a lawsuit against OpenAI on Friday in the [U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/10/apple-sues-openai-over-alleged-trade-secret-theft/), alleging trade secret theft and breach of contract carried out through former Apple employees who now work at the AI company. The suit names OpenAI, its hardware unit io Products, [OpenAI Chief Hardware Officer Tang Tan](https://www.engadget.com/2212759/apple-calls-openais-hardware-b...
